title: DR catalog additions for codebase-memory-mcp edges: technology layer (2 new relationship types)
rationale: Phase 2 maps every codebase-memory-mcp (CBM) edge the relationship catalog can hold (spec/analyzers/cbm/edge-mapping.json). These CBM edges have no catalog triple to land on: INHERITS, OVERRIDE, EMITS, ASYNC_CALLS, RAISES, LISTENS_ON (interface level), CONTAINS_FOLDER, HTTP_CALLS (and the gRPC, GraphQL and tRPC variants) and CONNECTS_TO. Each addition below is a new meaning between its pair, checked against the catalog so that none restates an existing relationship in the other direction (design charter: one meaning, one predicate). The inventory's addition 6 (component uses application service) was dropped for that reason: application.applicationservice serves application.applicationcomponent already says it. Additions 8 and 10 were dropped because the existing reversed triples (technology.systemsoftware serves application.applicationcomponent; technology.node composes technology.artifact) express SPAWNS and DEPLOYS. Source: docs/analyzers/CBM_MAPPING_INVENTORY.md, 'Catalog additions the edge mapping would need'.

fields.title: technology.node depends-on technology.technologyservice
fields.description: A node (a workload or compose service) depends on a technology service it connects to; it cannot run correctly when that service is unavailable. This is the consumer side, distinct from technology.technologyservice depends-on technology.node, where the service depends on the node that hosts it.

operations.rationale: A node (a workload or compose service) depends on a technology service it connects to; it cannot run correctly when that service is unavailable. This is the consumer side, distinct from technology.technologyservice depends-on technology.node, where the service depends on the node that hosts it. Needed to map the CBM edge CONNECTS_TO (inventory addition 9).

evidence.quote: A Kubernetes Deployment or docker-compose service whose environment, config or code addresses another Service by name (DATABASE_URL=postgres://db:5432, http://payments-svc); CBM CONNECTS_TO.
Observed in the eval corpora: CONNECTS_TO documented by CBM, not observed (needs the infrastructure pass).

The reverse triple exists with a different meaning: technology.technologyservice depends-on technology.node is the hosting dependency (a service needs the node it runs on); this is the consumer dependency (a workload needs a service it calls). depends-on is directional, so the two are different meanings.

fields.title: technology.node depends-on technology.node
fields.description: A node depends on another node to run: it is started after it and fails without it, as a compose service declares depends_on another service.

operations.rationale: A node depends on another node to run: it is started after it and fails without it, as a compose service declares depends_on another service. Needed to map the CBM edge DEPENDS_ON (inventory addition 9).

evidence.quote: A docker-compose service with depends_on: [db], or an init container or startup probe that waits for another workload, each side modelled as a technology node; CBM DEPENDS_ON between infrastructure nodes.
Observed in the eval corpora: infrastructure DEPENDS_ON (docker-compose depends_on between services); needs the infrastructure pass.
